answer: Jade Ledger Burn. Each identity must publish a signed ledger of tiny, random-jittered keepalive transactions; the system tracks the delta between declared and observed heartbeat spacing. Identities whose spacing variance sits too far inside a narrow canyon of near-perfect regularity get flagged as scripted fleets. Cost: attackers must run each fake agent for weeks on real irregular schedules, paying compute and latency noise per identity.
